title: Switchyard House Admission
objective: Admit the now-proven Switchyard resolver as a current OTHRYS OS House resident without duplicating routing backends: manifest, Book, component contract, Atlas/Mnemosyne projection and anti-drift tests must move together.
laws: A House resident must have exactly one manifest identity, one current Book and one component contract.
Switchyard owns deterministic selection evidence only; provider health, certification, Trust Canal authority and worker execution remain elsewhere.
Atlas and Mnemosyne remain derived projections and cannot promote Switchyard by themselves.
Admission must remove only the obsolete quarry-only prohibition for Switchyard, not Prometheus, Rhea or Visual Control.
